courses.subject: POL
courses.title: Elementary Polish I
courses.description: Oral and written work on basic pronunciation, grammar, and vocabulary. For students with no prior work in Polish.

courses.subject: POL
courses.title: Intro to Polish Culture
courses.description: Introduction to Polish culture and literature from a broad historical perspective. Drawing on novels and plays, film, the visual arts, and works of historical research, the course provides students with the basic concepts, methodologies and theories of literary and cultural interpretation, with an emphasis on modern Polish culture (1800-2010) within a broader European context. Same as REES 115.

courses.subject: POL
courses.title: Second Yr Polish I
courses.description: Grammar review, conversation practice, written exercises, and selected readings.

courses.subject: POL
courses.title: Survey of Polish Literature
courses.description: Critical survey, in translation, of Polish literature from the Middle Ages to the end of the nineteenth century; special attention given to the works in their cultural context. Same as CWL 245.

courses.subject: POL
courses.title: Third-Year Polish I
courses.description: Reading and discussion of representative prose and poetry works of Polish authors since 1863. All readings are in the original language; the course emphasis is in the development of language skills.

courses.subject: POL
courses.title: Third-Year Polish II
courses.description: Reading and discussion of representative prose and poetry works of Polish authors to 1863. All readings are in the original language; the course emphasis is in the development of language skills.

courses.subject: POL
courses.title: Fourth-Year Polish I
courses.description: Analysis of the sound system and grammar of the contemporary Polish language. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours.
courses.prereqText: Knowledge of another Slavic language or consent of instructor.

courses.subject: POL
courses.title: Fourth-Year Polish II
courses.description: Reading and analysis of selected texts. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours.

courses.subject: POL
courses.title: Problems of Polish Literature
courses.description: Critical study, in translation, of modern Polish fiction, drama, poetry, and essay, from Young Poland to the "New Wave"; their contribution to literary styles and genres in Poland and abroad; special emphasis on Wyspianski, Witkiewicz, and Gombrowicz. Same as CWL 436. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours.
